Name: Healthcare Cost Inflation
Description: Year-over-year change in medical care CPI component
Notes: Below threshold but still exceeds general CPI; employers report 7-9% actual increases

Name: Hospital Price Growth
Description: Year-over-year change in hospital services pricing
Notes: CPI may understate true hospital cost growth

Name: Prescription Drug Cost Growth
Description: Year-over-year change in prescription drug costs
Current Value: Moderating due to IRA; employers project 12% increase for 2026
Notes: IRA caps help Medicare; commercial still rising; GLP-1s driving employer costs

Name: OOP as Share of Income
Description: Household out-of-pocket healthcare spending as % of income
Current Value: Rising — deductible alone is 3-5% of median income
Notes: $1,886 deductible = ~3% of $60K median; add copays/premiums = higher

Name: Average Deductible Burden
Description: Average annual deductible relative to median income
Current Value: $1,886 avg; $2,631 small firms; 53% small firm workers face $2,000+
Notes: +17% since 2020; +43% over decade; 34% of all workers face $2,000+

Name: Catastrophic Cost Exposure
Description: Share of population with catastrophic medical cost vulnerability
Current Value: 23% underinsured (Commonwealth Fund); 57% of underinsured forgo care
Notes: 66% of underinsured have employer coverage — not just individual market problem

Name: Medical Debt Prevalence
Description: Share of adults with any medical debt
Current Value: 20-41% depending on definition (20% CFPB narrow; 41% KFF broad)
Notes: $88B in collections; CFPB rule vacated July 2025

Name: Medical Debt in Collections
Description: Share of adults with medical debt in third-party collections
Current Value: 4.1% (9.7M consumers) — down from 27M due to credit bureau changes, not actual improvement
Notes: Apparent improvement is policy artifact; underlying debt unchanged

Name: Average Medical Debt Balance
Description: Average medical debt balance among those with debt
Current Value: TBD — varies by study; total $88B across ~20% of population
Notes: Need more specific data on average balance

Name: Care Deferral Rate
Description: Share of adults who delayed or skipped care due to cost
Current Value: 33-36% (Gallup 33%, KFF 36%); 18% say health worsened; 47% worried about 2026 (record)
Notes: TX/MT/AK highest (41-43%); record anxiety about 2026 costs

Name: Medication Non-Adherence Rate
Description: Share not taking medications as prescribed due to cost
Current Value: 20.2% (2022); causes $528B annual cost, 100K deaths, 25% of hospitalizations
Notes: Insulin, CV, mental health highest risk categories

Name: Unmet Healthcare Need
Description: Share with unmet healthcare need due to cost
Current Value: 11% cannot access quality healthcare (Gallup 2025); higher for dental
Notes: Dental often highest unmet need; disparities by race/income
